summary: Excessive connection errors due to insufficient max_connections and inefficient connection handling in background jobs.
symptoms: Background jobs fail due to connection exhaustion.
mechanism: Background job processes (e.g., Sidekiq) create excessive concurrent connections, exceeding max_connections and causing failures.

facts.evidence: Post includes SHOW STATUS output showing Connection_errors_max_connections = 19102.
Post describes Sidekiq configuration with 4 processes and 200 jobs per process.
Post includes SHOW STATUS output showing Threads_connected = 501 during job execution.

assumptions: Background jobs are not efficiently releasing connections.
Sidekiq pool size is unnecessarily high for the workload.
Connection pooling or wait_timeout settings may be suboptimal.
unknowns: Exact workload characteristics of the background jobs.
Whether connection pooling is implemented in the Rails applications.
